summary: Boston Properties Limited Partnership filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $700.0 million offering of 6.050% Senior Notes due 2036. The notes were sold via underwriters led by J.P. Morgan and others, with net proceeds of approximately $692.4 million. The proceeds will partially fund the redemption of $1.0 billion of 2.750% Senior Notes due October 1, 2026, with the remainder from cash or credit facilities. This is a routine debt refinancing transaction, not a special situation, and does not constitute an event triggering special-situation classification.
